units.source_text: 很早以前，我就很喜欢川奈这种明朗而开阔的景色，

en.t: Long before then, I had loved this bright, open scenery of Kawana,

units.source_text: 很希望郁郁寡欢的名人去欣赏和享受一番，于是我悄悄地观察名人的样子。

en.t: and I very much hoped that the melancholy Master would admire and enjoy it, so I quietly watched his expression.

units.source_text: 名人恍恍惚惚的，不像是在观赏景色，视线也不投向周围的客人。

en.t: The Master seemed dazed and absent, as if he were not looking at the scenery, and his gaze did not turn toward the guests around him either.

units.source_text: 他不动声色，也没有说一句有关景致或饭店的话，照例由夫人来周旋。

en.t: He showed no reaction and did not say a single word about the view or the hotel; as usual, his wife handled the conversation.

units.source_text: 她赞赏风光佳美，并问名人有没有同感。

en.t: She praised the beauty of the scenery and asked the Master whether he felt the same.
The Master neither nodded nor objected.
